title: Original-DOS movement fixture
description: One movement query run through the executed routines (demo: reach search 0b06:0331 with its cost routine 0b06:09c1, destination list 0b06:1383 with the end-cell check 10cc:0f74, path search 0b06:0e12) on a DOS map: Width x Height cells numbered row by row, column = cell % width, odd columns half a cell lower. Numbers only; unit types index the build's UNIT.DAT records and terrain the build's terrain records, whose movement fields are the "move" tables of the build's dosrules profile (internal/dosrules/demo.json).

flags4.description: Live word +4: the type's +0x0d word ORed with the side bit (1 side 1, 2 neutral); 0x10 air, 0x40 a two-cell ship (0x80 its head), 0x1000 transporter.

flags6.description: Live word +6: 0x10 gives every enterable cell a cost of 2; 0x01 makes the order code pass block 0xffff.

fill.description: Terrain record of every cell not listed in cells.

units.description: Units on the moving side's own map.

unseen.description: Units on the other side's map only; the queries do not read it.

unit.description: Live unit index of the moving unit.

budget.description: The budget argument; callers pass live byte 0, which the constructor copies from type byte 0.

block.description: Terrain flag mask that closes a cell (the order code passes 3 for side 0, 6 for side 1, 0xffff for live +6 bit 1).

goals.description: Path targets, a subset of the destinations.

remaining.description: The cost buffer after the reach search, per cell in cell order (signed byte): the budget left on reaching the cell; below 0 the negated entry cost, -80 closed, -102/-101 a zone of control of side 0/1, -1 untouched.

count.description: Cells reached (AX of the reach search).

destinations.description: Cells the unit may end on, in the order the routine lists them (column by column); null where the end-cell check reaches its container branch (recorded in container-fixture form instead).

codes.description: [cell, end code] for reached cells outside the container branch (see container-fixture.schema.json): 0 allowed, 0x37 a unit of another side, 0x39 an own unit carrying nothing, 0x40 terrain closed to the unit.

paths.description: Per goal, the cells from the goal back to the start, or null where the search failed.
